name: snell-skills
description: McKay Snell's agent skills, packaged as one Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: snell-skills
plugins.description: McKay Snell's agent skills: html-plan (plans as one page you answer in one paste), html-explain (pages that teach a topic), html-house-style (the shared look), e2e-test (tests what you just built in the real app), demo-video (hands-free demo videos of your app), frontend-vibe (find the feel of a frontend before building it), and to-markdown.
